issues.description: Parameter type for the oracle's 'combination' argument is inconsistent between the problem statement, the template, and the solution. The problem statement explicitly describes 'combination' as a bit-string (string) for Exercise 2 (e.g., "10000"). In the template (ex2_grover_multi_qubit_with_auxiliary_qubit.py) the oracle() stub is declared with combination: list[int], while the grover_circuit() stub in the same template expects combination: str. The reference solution uses a string for combination. This internal mismatch in the template (and the discrepancy with the problem text) will confuse students about the expected type and how to write their oracle implementation.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the type of 'combination' consistent across problem, template, and solution. Since the problem statement and reference solution treat 'combination' as a bit-string, update the template oracle signature to use combination: str (and update any docstrings/comments accordingly). Alternatively, if an array type is intended, update the problem text and all signatures consistently to use list[int].
